#448.summary: The Final verification and Supervisor check steps are gone, so a ticket goes from QA straight to Merging.
#448.title: Remove the Final verification and Supervisor check flows

TP-880.summary: The Supervisor check no longer runs; tickets go from QA straight to Merging.
TP-880.title: Remove the Supervisor check

TP-891.summary: Removes the review states nobody uses any more, and the switch between the old and new flows.
TP-891.title: Remove the retired review states and the version switch from the code

TP-892.summary: PR open, sent back by Code Review twice over old wording.
TP-892.title: Retire two old review steps

TP-893.summary: The ticket page shows Code Review and QA as the only review steps.
TP-893.title: Show the new review steps in the app

review.if_unanswered: TP-892 stays in Rework, and TP-893 can't start because it waits on TP-892.

options.effect: TP-892 goes back to Code Review with a note that TP-891 removes the old instructions.
options.label: Leave them to TP-891

tradeoffs.text: TP-892 can merge today, and TP-893 can start.
The old instructions stay until TP-891 lands, about two days.

options.effect: The next run removes Final verification from the old instructions, and TP-892 goes back to Code Review.
options.label: Update them in TP-892 now

tradeoffs.text: Another review round, about half a day.
TP-891 then has to work around the change and may conflict with it.

options.effect: TP-892 waits in Rework until TP-891 is done, then goes back to Code Review unchanged.
options.label: Wait for TP-891 to land first

tradeoffs.text: TP-892 needs no change at all.
TP-892 and TP-893 wait about two days.

review.question: TP-892 (Retire two old review steps) is done except that the old workflow's instructions still describe the Final verification step. TP-891 (Remove the retired review states) deletes those instructions anyway. Should TP-892 update them now, or leave them to TP-891?
review.recommendation_reason: TP-891 removes these instructions this week, so updating them twice adds work without changing what you see.
review.title: Update the old workflow's instructions now, or leave them to TP-891?
review.unblocks: TP-893, the app's view of the new review steps
review.why:
Code Review sent #448 back twice. Both times its only finding was that the old instructions still describe Final verification.

TP-880 already removed the Supervisor check. TP-891 removes the rest of the old review states, with these instructions, this week.
